description: Experience Castlevania: Dawn of Sorrow through an independent native PC recompilation of the original Nintendo DS game. Enjoy HD-2D graphics, Direct3D 12 and Vulkan, customizable widescreen and dual-screen layouts, modern controls, modular mods, custom soundtracks and an in-game F1 settings menu. Windows x64 is the tested platform. Bring your own legally dumped USA ROM; optional translation and community patches are obtained separately.
features: Native static ARM9/ARM7 recompilation; approximately 60 FPS in documented Windows tests
HD-2D GPU upscaling, anti-dithering, bloom and visual presets
Widescreen Theatre, ultrawide, customizable dual-screen layouts and minimap HUD
Keyboard, mouse, Xbox and PlayStation controller support
Modular stackable IPS, XDelta and DOS patches with isolated saves
Custom WAV, MP3 and OGG music, per-stage mapping and global jukebox
Independent audio controls, save states and screenshots
English and Brazilian Portuguese interface; optional authorized PT-BR v1.1 patch
Optional GBA Slot-2 Aria of Sorrow bonus (no GBA ROM required)
requirements: Windows 10 or newer (64-bit); compatible Direct3D 12 or Vulkan 1.1 graphics device recommended. Your own legally dumped, unmodified USA Nintendo DS ROM (.nds, ACVE, 67,108,864 bytes, CRC32 135737F6, SHA-1 47530ff87e608f88105a314fdf36dc385f8dec94). No commercial BIOS or additional emulator required. Optional third-party mods and translations must be obtained separately from their authors.

setup_steps: Install the recomp through RecompLauncher or add the official release ZIP.
In Easy Setup, select your unmodified USA Nintendo DS ROM (ACVE).
Allow the launcher to verify the game file and press Play.
Press F1 to customize graphics, controls, layouts, audio and mods.
Optionally import compatible community patches or custom music; no manual compilation or ROM modification is required.
